RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the December 5, 2006/Agrahayana 14, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism;
Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Harassment of tax payers
*181. SHRI PRAVEEN RASHTRA-
PAL: Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Board of Direct
Taxes (CBDT) has recently spelt out
measures to deal with taxpayers' grievances
in the event of their Income Tax Return
statements being taken up for scrutiny by
the Income Tax Department;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that genuine tax
payers are being harassed by the I.T.
Department by issuing these notices from
time-to-time; and
(d) if so, what steps are being taken by
the I.T. Department to ensure that genuine
tax payers are not harassed by the income
tax authorities?
Service Tax on medical profession
*182. SHRI PENUMALLI
MADHU:
SHRIMATI BRINDA
KARAT:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there are any concessions
in taxation for some medical institutes;
(b) whether Government consider to
exclude Service Tax on medical profession;
and
(c) in how many States the medical
profession is taxed and what is the
percentage of tax on medical profession?
Dwindling of ground water table
*183. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the ground
water table is dwindling year by year;
(b) if so, the details of ground level water
table between 2000 and 2005, State-wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that the drawing
of water higher than specified by Cola
companies in various places is also a
contributing factor for the lower level
ground water tables;
(d) what is the difference between an
underground water table in the areas
adjacent to Cola companies and other
places in each State;

58
(e) whether this is contributing to
the shortage of underground water
for agricultural activities in those areas;
and
(f) if so, what steps are being taken by
Government to rectify this anomaly?
Committee on pricing of gas
*184. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have
appointed any Committee to go into
various aspects of pricing of gas produced
under the New Exploration Licensing
Policy (NELP);
(b) if so, what is the composition of
this Committee; and
(c) whether representatives of other
Government Departments were associated
in the Committee and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Memorial for Morarji Desai
*185. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether  Government have any
proposal to develop a memorial 'Abhay
Ghat' in the memory of former
Prime Minister of India, late Shri Morarji
Desai;
(b) if so, the steps being taken in this
regard; and
(c) by when the memorial is likely to be
completed?
Independent security agency at
airports to monitor ground
handling operations
*186. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether to check up airport security,
the Ministry of Home Affairs has suggested
creation of an independent security agency
to monitor ground handling operations at
major airports, various sensitive functions
including check-in, passenger facilitation,
cleaning of aircraft, loading, unloading and
pushback facility;
(b) if so, whether the specialized agency
will include the experts from various
organisations like the Directorate General
of Civil Aviation, Bureau of Civil Aviation
Security, Central Industrial Security Force
and Airports Authority of India;
(c) if so, whether Ministry has
considered the suggestions; and
(d) if so, by when a final decision will
be taken?
Maintenance of cemeteries
*187. SHRI MAHENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that foreign
citizens are visiting India to see the
cemeteries of their forefathers in Lucknow,
Kanpur, Meerut and other places;
(b) whether it is also a fact that their
number is likely to increase in the year 2007
in view of 150th year of the First War of
Independence in 1857; and

59
(c) if so, the arrangements made by
Government in this regard for the tourists
and the maintenance of these places?
DRI notices on purchase of imported
cars
*188. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Directorate of Revenue
Intelligence has issued notices to a chosen
few with regard to purchase of imported
cars;
(b) if so, the details of the persons to
whom DRI had issued notices giving
reasons therefor;
(c) whether senior bureaucrats etc. have
been let off in the matter of purchase of
imported cars; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Withdrawal of tax exemption on direct
and indirect taxes

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the December 5, 2006/Agrahayana 14, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 155

Violation of guidelines in No-Fly zone
1329. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Civil Aviation
authorities are not performing their duty
faithfully and properly;
(b) if so, the number of foreign civil
aircrafts strayed into No-Fly zone over
Prime Minister's residence and Rashtrapati
Bhawan during the last six months;
(c) the reasons for not giving proper
guidance/instructions to such foreign pilots,
and who are responsible for such negligence
in performing their proper duty; and
(d) the action taken/to be taken for non
repetition of such acts in future?
Creation of Airport Approval
Commission
†1330. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in view of
requirement of new airports in various parts
of the country, Government have
considered setting up of an Airport
Approval Commission for their approval;
(b) if so, by when such a Commission
will be set up; and
(c) the details of objectives and
functions of the Commission?
Calculation of rent for hangar
†1331. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the existing policy for handing over
the assets (hangars and land etc.) of Airports
Authority of India to State Governments
for administrative purposes;
(b) the methodology adopted by
Airports Authority of India to fix rentals
for their barracks and hangars;
(c) whether there is any problem for
giving these premises free for non-
commercial use;
(d) whether the State Government of
Madhya Pradesh has forwarded any
proposal to waive off the rentals of the
barracks and hangars of aerodrome which
are lying in condemned position; and

300
(e) if so, the action taken thereon?
AAI's bid for management of Abuja
airport
1332. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Airports Authority of India
(AAI) has bid for the rights to operate and
manage the airport in Abuja, Nigeria;
(b) the quantum of air and passenger
traffic at the domestic and the international
airport in Abuja; and
(c) the tentative financial involvement
and technical collaboration, if any, to offer
a world class package?
Setting up new international airports
in the country
†1333. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of number of international
airports at present, State-wise;
(b) whether approval has been accorded
to set up new international airports;
(c) if so, the places where these
international airports are likely to be set
up as well as the number of such airports;
and
(d) by when these international airports
are likely to be started?
Free air passage to retired
bureaucrats
1334. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that retired
bureaucrats of Indian Airlines and Air India
are provided with free air passage;
(b) if so, the number of bureaucrats
availed of free air passage during the last
three years; and
(c) what are the destination mostly
preferred by bureaucrats?
Agreement for purchase of aircrafts
†1335. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the status of agreement signed by
Air India and Indian Airlines for purchase
of new aeroplanes;
(b) by when Air India and Indian
Airlines will get the Airbus and Boeing
aircrafts for which purchase agreement has
been signed and the reasons for the delay;
and
(c) the number of aircrafts with Indian
Airlines and Air India at present, the
number of airworthy aircrafts out of the
same?
Usage charges on private airlines
1336. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of various charges/fees
levied by Government on private airlines
in domestic sector for using facilities like
runway, taxi track, hangar etc., on aircraft
basis;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

301
(b) how these charges/fees are
determined; and
(c) when this was last revised?
New entrants in aviation sector
1337. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of applications which
are pending from private companies seeking
permission to enter into the aviation
industry;
(b) whether adequate facilities are
available in the airports of this country to
handle heavy rush of aircrafts; and
(c) what is the plan of Government to
reduce airport taxes in some of the airports
